title: Four content-model rules

hotspots.label: Stable IDs
hotspots.detail: Derive the document ID from the source's immutable identifier, not a title, slug, or URL. A changed ID is a different document, and bulk replacement deletes the old one.

hotspots.label: One object, one document
hotspots.detail: It may be better to combine relational data into a single document object to be indexed.

hotspots.label: Timestamps
hotspots.detail: Use epoch seconds. With the SDK, created_at and updated_at must be epoch seconds, not ISO strings.

hotspots.label: Links
hotspots.detail: Each viewURL must match the datasource urlRegex, which must be neither too broad nor too narrow.

footnote: The stable-ID rule is studio guidance derived from the sourced replacement behavior.
